packing: glTF G=forward roughness; B=bounded scalar specular; factors=1; runtime converts B to R once

Kanden_Body1.reason: Broad restrained organic-carapace response, reducing clipped original Phong boost while preserving painted highlights.

Kanden_Body2.reason: Softer secondary body plates with less uniform shine than the main shell.

Noxus_Body1.reason: Restrained broad body response retains Source painted shading.

Noxus_Body2.reason: Keep authored exponent35 shape while replacing clipped boost9 with a bounded highlight.

Spire_Body.reason: Matte rock surface retains authored broad lobe and reduces the residual uniform shine.

Spire_Torso.reason: Slightly distinct torso-rock response; crystal/glow regions are preserved.

Sylux_Body1.reason: Armor main panels get a narrower bounded lobe rather than clipped boost3.

Sylux_Body2.reason: Secondary armor is softer and less glossy, with identical original normals/artwork.

Trace_Body.reason: Subdued shell highlights retain silhouette and painted Source forms.

Weavel_Body.reason: Armor highlights narrow without amplifying already-painted bright contours.

Weavel_Handgun.reason: Weapon housing separates from body armor with a modest tighter response.

Weavel_Handgun2.reason: Original separately-authored weapon trim gets a tighter lobe than the housing.

scope: Unaccepted authored forward-material response candidate. Scalars are art choices for GPU comparison, not measured physical roughness or metalness. Original Source Phong alpha-mask regions, albedo/recolors/normals/emission, native lighting/status, and geometry remain unchanged. No procedural de-lighting, 4K repaint, Fresnel reconstruction, or fabricated surface segmentation. Selfillum/glow source materials are unchanged. Mobile tiers must be rebuilt after desktop acceptance.
